 St. Louis CITY SC crowned U.S. Open Cup champions, U-17 WNT advances to Round of 16 at the U-17 FIFA Women’s World Cup, seven USMNT players score in league play October 26, 2026 The NWSL playoffs are right around the corner, meanwhile USMNT players and U.S. Youth and Extended National Teams are leaving their marks on the world stage. Here’s a look at last week’s biggest moments across the U.S. Soccer landscape.
 USWNT 
 NWSL playoff race heats up 
 With just one matchday left in the 2026 NWSL regular season, seven teams have clinched their spot in the playoffs. At the top of the standings is Gotham FC, which earned a 2-1 win on Saturday behind a game-winner by center back Tierna Davidson. Decision Day on Nov. 1 will determine whether Gotham or San Diego Wave FC secures the Supporters’ Shield. Another USWNT defender on the scoresheet this weekend was Gisele Thompson, who helped Angel City FC to a 2-0 win as the team is still in the hunt for a top-four spot and home field advantage in the first round of the playoffs.
 Gisele Thompson gets it DONE 😤
Her fifth of the season puts Angel City in front! https://t.co/UO6ADFUL6m
— National Women’s Soccer League (@NWSL) October 25, 2026 
 From the outside looking in are Seattle Reign FC, North Carolina Courage and Denver Summit FC. Goalkeeper Claudia Dickey made four saves against Utah Royals FC on Friday to earn a crucial point for the Reign, which is holding on to the final playoff spot. Golden Boot leader Ashley Sanchez and the Courage will host captain Lindsey Heaps and the Summit on Decision Day, with the winner possibly earning the last playoff spot with a Seattle loss to Orlando.
 View the NWSL standings here .
 Croix Bethune sets new assists record 
 Also heading to the NWSL postseason is the Kansas City Current, which features the new single-season assists record holder Croix Bethune. The midfielder earned her 11th assist of the season and her 23rd career assist in the Current’s 2-1 victory over the Washington Spirit on Sunday. Bethune logged 10 assists in her rookie season in 2024, tying the league record set by Tobin Heath in 2016.

@CroixBethune always serving assists on a platter 🤌 https://t.co/Uczu7MCMms

 USMNT 
 Seven MNT players find the back of the net 
 The past week saw seven different USMNT players score in international and domestic play, three of which scored their first of the season. Defender Alex Freeman scored the equalizer in Villareal’s 2-1 win over Valencia, the 22-year-old's first in La Liga, while midfielder Weston McKennie got on the end of a free kick to open the scoring for Juventus in a 2-0 win against Lecce. Forward Tim Weah also scored his first of the season for Marseille, maneuvering past three defenders inside the box to net the second goal in the team’s 4-3 win over Le Havre.
 Weah refused to be stopped! 💪 https://t.co/7mgYspyJMj
— Ligue 1 English (@Ligue1_ENG) October 25, 2026 
 Also scoring abroad was AC Milan midfielder Christian Pulisic, who scored his second of the season on Sunday in the 2-0 win over Udinese. Defender Joe Scally netted his team-leading third goal of the campaign to lift Borussia Mönchengladbach to its first win this year. Meanwhile in MLS, 19-year-old Neil Pierre, who earned his first USMNT cap last month, scored his fifth goal of the season for Philadelphia Union.
 USOC 
 St. Louis SC Crowned 2026 U.S. Open Cup Champions 
 St. Louis CITY SC earned its first-ever trophy last week after defeating hosts Columbus Crew in the final of the 111th edition of the Lamar Hunt U.S. Soccer Open Cup. Following 120 minutes of scoreless action, CITY SC downed the Crew in a penalty kick shootout, 5-3, at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field to become the 11th team from St. Louis to win the tournament.
 USYNT 
 U-17 WNT heads to Round of 16 at FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup 
 The U.S. Under-17 Women’s National Team advanced to the knockout rounds of the U-17 FIFA Women’s World Cup in Morocco after finishing second in Group E. Head coach Ciara Crinion’s side rolled past Samoa, 17-0 , in the opening match before winning 6-1 against Kenya and falling 3-2 against China PR. The team will face Spain in the Round of 16 on Thursday, Oct. 29.
 Forward Maddie DiMaria has already broken multiple records throughout the tournament. After scoring six goals against Samoa, she netted four more against Kenya and one against China PR. The 11 goals set a USYNT, USWNT and FIFA Women’s World Cup record for most goals by a player at any level in a FIFA Women’s World Cup tournament. She now has 23 goals in 20 caps at the U-17 level.

— U.S. Soccer YNT (@USYNT) October 22, 2026 
 USENT 
 CP WNT and MNT, Power National Team Place at World Cups 
 Three U.S. Extended National Teams earned podium finishes at their respective World Cups last week. The CP WNT won its second IFCPF World Cup title after defeating Australia, 3-2 , in an impressive comeback victory at the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center. The team won all four of its matches and outscored its opponents 26-4 during the tournament.
 On the men’s side, the CP MNT took home silver for its best World Cup finish in program history. The team made a dominant run through the competition, scoring 21 goals while conceding only three, but fell 2-1 in extra time to England in the final.
 In Argentina, the U.S. Power National Team took home third place after defeating the hosts 2-1 in the Bronze Medal Match . Lexi Heer scored the stoppage-time game-winner to complete the comeback win and ensure a top-three finish for the USA in the FIPFA Powerchair Football World Cup for the fifth-consecutive tournament.
